"""cocotb tests for crc8_block.

Expected values come from a model written from interface_spec.md, clauses
CRC-RESET, CRC-INIT, CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-HOLD, CRC-FINAL and CRC-EMPTY.
The model is not copied from the RTL.

Timing: inputs change on the falling edge of clk. The rising edge takes them.
crc is checked on the next falling edge, when it has settled.
"""

import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import FallingEdge, RisingEdge

START = 0xFF
POLY = 0x07


def model_take_byte(running, byte):
    """CRC-POLY / CRC-ORDER, written in byte-wise form.

    The spec says: for bit 7 down to 0, XOR the bit into the top bit, shift
    left, and XOR with 0x07 if the bit shifted out was 1. XORing the whole
    byte into the running value first and then shifting 8 times gives the
    same result for an MSB-first, unreflected CRC.
    """
    r = (running ^ byte) & 0xFF
    for _ in range(8):
        if r & 0x80:
            r = ((r << 1) ^ POLY) & 0xFF
        else:
            r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
    return r


def model_take_byte_bitwise(running, byte):
    """Literal bit-by-bit reading of the spec. Used to cross-check the model."""
    r = running
    for i in range(7, -1, -1):
        bit = (byte >> i) & 1
        r ^= bit << 7
        out = (r >> 7) & 1
        r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
        if out:
            r ^= POLY
    return r


def model_crc(running):
    """CRC-FINAL: crc is the running value with every bit inverted."""
    return running ^ 0xFF


class Model:
    """Running value of the block, as the spec defines it."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.running = None  # unknown before the first reset

    def edge(self, rst_n, init, valid, data):
        """Apply one rising edge."""
        if not rst_n:
            self.running = START          # CRC-RESET
        elif init:
            self.running = START          # CRC-INIT: reload wins over the byte
        elif valid:
            self.running = model_take_byte(self.running, data)  # CRC-POLY
        # else: CRC-HOLD, no change

    def crc(self):
        return model_crc(self.running)


def read_crc(dut):
    v = dut.crc.value
    assert v.is_resolvable, f"crc is not 0/1: {v}"
    return int(v)


class Bench:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.model = Model()
        self.checks = 0

    async def start(self):
        cocotb.start_soon(Clock(self.dut.clk, 10, "ns").start())
        self.dut.rst_n.value = 0
        self.dut.init.value = 0
        self.dut.valid.value = 0
        self.dut.data.value = 0
        await FallingEdge(self.dut.clk)

    async def cycle(self, rst_n=1, init=0, valid=0, data=0, what=""):
        """Drive the inputs for one edge, then check crc after it.

        The bench is already at a falling edge when this is called.
        """
        d = self.dut
        d.rst_n.value = rst_n
        d.init.value = init
        d.valid.value = valid
        d.data.value = data
        await RisingEdge(d.clk)
        self.model.edge(rst_n, init, valid, data)
        await FallingEdge(d.clk)
        got = read_crc(d)
        exp = self.model.crc()
        assert got == exp, (
            f"{what}: crc=0x{got:02X} expected 0x{exp:02X} after edge with "
            f"rst_n={rst_n} init={init} valid={valid} data=0x{data:02X}"
        )
        self.checks += 1
        return got

    async def reset(self, cycles=3):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            await self.cycle(rst_n=0, what="reset")


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_model_against_hand_vectors(dut):
    """Check the model itself against vectors worked out by hand from the spec."""
    # 0xFF XOR 0xFF = 0, and shifting 0 eight times gives 0.
    assert model_take_byte(0xFF, 0xFF) == 0x00
    # Worked by hand, bit by bit, from 0xFF with byte 0x00.
    assert model_take_byte(0xFF, 0x00) == 0xF3
    # 0xFF ^ 0x80 = 0x7F, then eight shifts.
    assert model_take_byte(0xFF, 0x80) == 0x7D
    rng = random.Random(1)
    for _ in range(500):
        s, b = rng.randrange(256), rng.randrange(256)
        assert model_take_byte(s, b) == model_take_byte_bitwise(s, b), (s, b)

    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00, "CRC-EMPTY after reset"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_and_empty(dut):
    """CRC-RESET, CRC-EMPTY: reset loads 0xFF and wins over init and valid."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    # Reset held with a byte offered: reset must win.
    await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, init=0, valid=1, data=0x5A, what="reset with valid")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, init=1, valid=1, data=0xA5, what="reset with init+valid")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    # Empty frame after a reload.
    await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_single_bytes_hand_vectors(dut):
    """CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-FINAL: absolute values worked out from the spec."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    vectors = {0xFF: 0xFF, 0x00: 0x0C, 0x80: 0x82, 0x01: None}
    for byte, exp in vectors.items():
        await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
        got = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=byte, what=f"byte 0x{byte:02X}")
        if exp is not None:
            assert got == exp, f"byte 0x{byte:02X}: crc 0x{got:02X}, hand value 0x{exp:02X}"
    # Order matters: 0x80 and 0x01 give different crc values from 0xFF.
    # A bit-reversed design would swap them.
    await bench.cycle(init=1)
    a = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x80)
    await bench.cycle(init=1)
    b = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x01)
    assert a != b
    assert a == 0x82


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_hold(dut):
    """CRC-HOLD: with valid low and init low the value does not change, whatever data is."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x3C, what="first byte")
    held = read_crc(dut)
    for d in (0x00, 0xFF, 0x55, 0xAA, 0x3C):
        got = await bench.cycle(valid=0, data=d, what="hold")
        assert got == held, f"hold changed crc to 0x{got:02X} from 0x{held:02X}"
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xC3, what="byte after hold")


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_init_priority_and_midframe(dut):
    """CRC-INIT: reload wins over a byte at the same edge, also in mid-frame."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    for b in (0x12, 0x34, 0x56):
        await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=b, what="frame A")
    assert read_crc(dut) != 0x00
    got = await bench.cycle(init=1, valid=1, data=0x78, what="init with valid")
    assert got == 0x00, "init must reload 0xFF, ignoring the byte"
    # A new frame starts from the start value.
    for b in (0xDE, 0xAD):
        await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=b, what="frame B")
    # Reset in the middle of a frame, with valid high.
    got = await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, valid=1, data=0xBE, what="reset mid-frame")
    assert got == 0x00
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xEF, what="after reset")


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=2000, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_random_frames(dut):
    """Seeded random traffic, checked after every edge, with corner counts."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    rng = random.Random(random.getrandbits(32))
    seen = {"byte": 0, "hold": 0, "init_with_valid": 0, "reset_with_valid": 0,
            "byte_ff": 0, "byte_00": 0}
    for _ in range(3000):
        r = rng.random()
        rst_n = 0 if r < 0.02 else 1
        init = 1 if rng.random() < 0.06 else 0
        valid = 1 if rng.random() < 0.7 else 0
        p = rng.random()
        data = 0x00 if p < 0.05 else 0xFF if p < 0.10 else rng.randrange(256)
        if not rst_n and valid:
            seen["reset_with_valid"] += 1
        elif rst_n and init and valid:
            seen["init_with_valid"] += 1
        elif rst_n and not init and valid:
            seen["byte"] += 1
            if data == 0xFF:
                seen["byte_ff"] += 1
            if data == 0x00:
                seen["byte_00"] += 1
        elif rst_n and not init and not valid:
            seen["hold"] += 1
        await bench.cycle(rst_n=rst_n, init=init, valid=valid, data=data, what="random")
    dut._log.info(f"corner counts {seen}, checks {bench.checks}")
    for k, v in seen.items():
        assert v > 0, f"random phase never reached corner {k}"

"""cocotb tests for crc8_block.

The expected values come from models written from interface_spec.md. The
clauses covered are CRC-RESET, CRC-INIT, CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-HOLD,
CRC-FINAL and CRC-EMPTY. No model is copied from the RTL.

There are three independent forms of CRC-POLY:
  * model_take_byte_bitwise: a literal bit-by-bit reading of the spec.
  * model_take_byte: the byte-wise form (XOR the byte in, then shift 8 times).
  * model_frame_poly: GF(2) algebra. After bytes b1..bn from start value S,
    the running value is (S*x^(8n) + M(x)*x^8) mod (x^8+x^2+x+1).

Hand vectors, worked bit by bit from start value 0xFF:
  byte 0x00 -> running 0xF3, crc 0x0C
  byte 0xFF -> running 0x00, crc 0xFF
  byte 0x80 -> running 0x7A, crc 0x85
  byte 0x01 -> running 0xF4, crc 0x0B
  bytes 0xFF 0xFF -> running 0xF3, crc 0x0C
These were cross-checked by linearity:
  running(0xFF, b) = 0xF3 ^ L(b), with L(0x01) = 0x07 and L(0x80) = 0x89.

Timing: inputs change on the falling edge of clk, and the rising edge takes
them. crc is checked on the next falling edge, after it has settled.
"""

import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer

START = 0xFF
POLY = 0x07
POLY_FULL = 0x107  # x^8 + x^2 + x + 1


def model_take_byte_bitwise(running, byte):
    """CRC-POLY / CRC-ORDER, taken literally from the spec, bit 7 first."""
    r = running & 0xFF
    for i in range(7, -1, -1):
        bit = (byte >> i) & 1
        r ^= bit << 7
        out = (r >> 7) & 1
        r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
        if out:
            r ^= POLY
    return r


def model_take_byte(running, byte):
    """Byte-wise form of the same MSB-first, unreflected update."""
    r = (running ^ byte) & 0xFF
    for _ in range(8):
        if r & 0x80:
            r = ((r << 1) ^ POLY) & 0xFF
        else:
            r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
    return r


def gf2_mod(a, p=POLY_FULL):
    """Remainder of a polynomial over GF(2), with polynomials held as ints."""
    deg = p.bit_length() - 1
    while a.bit_length() - 1 >= deg:
        a ^= p << (a.bit_length() - 1 - deg)
    return a


def model_frame_poly(start, data_bytes):
    """Running value after a frame, from polynomial algebra."""
    n = len(data_bytes)
    if n == 0:
        return start
    m = 0
    for b in data_bytes:
        m = (m << 8) | b
    return gf2_mod((start << (8 * n)) ^ (m << 8))


def model_crc(running):
    """CRC-FINAL: crc is the running value with every bit inverted."""
    return running ^ 0xFF


class Model:
    """Running value of the block, as the spec defines it."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.running = None  # unknown before the first reset

    def edge(self, rst_n, init, valid, data):
        """Apply one rising edge."""
        if not rst_n:
            self.running = START          # CRC-RESET
        elif init:
            self.running = START          # CRC-INIT: the reload wins over the byte
        elif valid:
            self.running = model_take_byte_bitwise(self.running, data)  # CRC-POLY
        # else: CRC-HOLD, no change

    def crc(self):
        return model_crc(self.running)


def read_crc(dut):
    v = dut.crc.value
    assert v.is_resolvable, f"crc is not 0/1: {v}"
    return int(v)


class Bench:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.model = Model()
        self.checks = 0

    async def start(self):
        cocotb.start_soon(Clock(self.dut.clk, 10, "ns").start())
        self.dut.rst_n.value = 0
        self.dut.init.value = 0
        self.dut.valid.value = 0
        self.dut.data.value = 0
        await FallingEdge(self.dut.clk)

    async def cycle(self, rst_n=1, init=0, valid=0, data=0, what=""):
        """Drive the inputs for one edge, then check crc after it.

        The bench is already at a falling edge when this is called.
        """
        d = self.dut
        d.rst_n.value = rst_n
        d.init.value = init
        d.valid.value = valid
        d.data.value = data
        await RisingEdge(d.clk)
        self.model.edge(rst_n, init, valid, data)
        await FallingEdge(d.clk)
        got = read_crc(d)
        exp = self.model.crc()
        assert got == exp, (
            f"{what}: crc=0x{got:02X} expected 0x{exp:02X} after edge with "
            f"rst_n={rst_n} init={init} valid={valid} data=0x{data:02X}"
        )
        self.checks += 1
        return got

    async def reset(self, cycles=3):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            await self.cycle(rst_n=0, what="reset")


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_model_against_hand_vectors(dut):
    """Check the three models against hand vectors and against each other."""
    hand = {0x00: 0xF3, 0xFF: 0x00, 0x80: 0x7A, 0x01: 0xF4}
    for byte, running in hand.items():
        assert model_take_byte_bitwise(0xFF, byte) == running, hex(byte)
        assert model_take_byte(0xFF, byte) == running, hex(byte)
        assert model_frame_poly(0xFF, [byte]) == running, hex(byte)
    assert model_frame_poly(0xFF, [0xFF, 0xFF]) == 0xF3
    # Linearity of the update in the byte.
    assert model_take_byte_bitwise(0x00, 0x01) == 0x07
    assert model_take_byte_bitwise(0x00, 0x80) == 0x89
    rng = random.Random(1)
    for _ in range(500):
        s, b = rng.randrange(256), rng.randrange(256)
        assert model_take_byte(s, b) == model_take_byte_bitwise(s, b), (s, b)
    for _ in range(200):
        frame = [rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 12))]
        r = START
        for b in frame:
            r = model_take_byte_bitwise(r, b)
        assert r == model_frame_poly(START, frame), frame

    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00, "CRC-EMPTY after reset"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_and_empty(dut):
    """CRC-RESET, CRC-EMPTY: reset loads 0xFF and wins over init and valid."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x5A, what="byte before reset")
    assert read_crc(dut) != 0x00
    # A byte is offered while reset is held: reset must win.
    await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, init=0, valid=1, data=0x5A, what="reset with valid")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, init=1, valid=1, data=0xA5, what="reset with init+valid")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    # An empty frame after a reload.
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x11, what="byte before reload")
    await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_single_bytes_hand_vectors(dut):
    """CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-FINAL: absolute values worked out from the spec."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    vectors = {0xFF: 0xFF, 0x00: 0x0C, 0x80: 0x85, 0x01: 0x0B}
    for byte, exp in vectors.items():
        await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
        got = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=byte, what=f"byte 0x{byte:02X}")
        assert got == exp, f"byte 0x{byte:02X}: crc 0x{got:02X}, hand value 0x{exp:02X}"
    # Two-byte frame FF FF.
    await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xFF, what="FF first")
    got = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xFF, what="FF second")
    assert got == 0x0C, f"frame FF FF: crc 0x{got:02X}, hand value 0x0C"
    # Order matters: 0x80 and 0x01 give different crc values. A bit-reversed
    # design would swap them.
    await bench.cycle(init=1)
    a = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x80)
    await bench.cycle(init=1)
    b = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x01)
    assert a == 0x85 and b == 0x0B, (hex(a), hex(b))


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_hold(dut):
    """CRC-HOLD: with valid low and init low the value does not change, whatever data is."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x3C, what="first byte")
    held = read_crc(dut)
    for d in (0x00, 0xFF, 0x55, 0xAA, 0x3C):
        got = await bench.cycle(valid=0, data=d, what="hold")
        assert got == held, f"hold changed crc to 0x{got:02X} from 0x{held:02X}"

"""cocotb tests for crc8_block.

The expected values come from models written from interface_spec.md. The
clauses covered are CRC-RESET, CRC-INIT, CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-HOLD,
CRC-FINAL and CRC-EMPTY. No model is copied from the RTL.

There are three independent forms of CRC-POLY:
  * model_take_byte_bitwise: a literal bit-by-bit reading of the spec.
  * model_take_byte: the byte-wise form (XOR the byte in, then shift 8 times).
  * model_frame_poly: GF(2) algebra. After bytes b1..bn from start value S,
    the running value is (S*x^(8n) + M(x)*x^8) mod (x^8+x^2+x+1).

Hand vectors, worked bit by bit from start value 0xFF:
  byte 0x00 -> running 0xF3, crc 0x0C
  byte 0xFF -> running 0x00, crc 0xFF
  byte 0x80 -> running 0x7A, crc 0x85
  byte 0x01 -> running 0xF4, crc 0x0B
  bytes 0xFF 0xFF -> running 0xF3, crc 0x0C
These were cross-checked by linearity:
  running(0xFF, b) = 0xF3 ^ L(b), with L(0x01) = 0x07 and L(0x80) = 0x89.

Timing: inputs change on the falling edge of clk, and the rising edge takes
them. crc is checked on the next falling edge, after it has settled.
"""

import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import FallingEdge, RisingEdge, Timer

START = 0xFF
POLY = 0x07
POLY_FULL = 0x107  # x^8 + x^2 + x + 1


def model_take_byte_bitwise(running, byte):
    """CRC-POLY / CRC-ORDER, taken literally from the spec, bit 7 first."""
    r = running & 0xFF
    for i in range(7, -1, -1):
        bit = (byte >> i) & 1
        r ^= bit << 7
        out = (r >> 7) & 1
        r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
        if out:
            r ^= POLY
    return r


def model_take_byte(running, byte):
    """Byte-wise form of the same MSB-first, unreflected update."""
    r = (running ^ byte) & 0xFF
    for _ in range(8):
        if r & 0x80:
            r = ((r << 1) ^ POLY) & 0xFF
        else:
            r = (r << 1) & 0xFF
    return r


def gf2_mod(a, p=POLY_FULL):
    """Remainder of a polynomial over GF(2), with polynomials held as ints."""
    deg = p.bit_length() - 1
    while a.bit_length() - 1 >= deg:
        a ^= p << (a.bit_length() - 1 - deg)
    return a


def model_frame_poly(start, data_bytes):
    """Running value after a frame, from polynomial algebra."""
    n = len(data_bytes)
    if n == 0:
        return start
    m = 0
    for b in data_bytes:
        m = (m << 8) | b
    return gf2_mod((start << (8 * n)) ^ (m << 8))


def model_crc(running):
    """CRC-FINAL: crc is the running value with every bit inverted."""
    return running ^ 0xFF


class Model:
    """Running value of the block, as the spec defines it."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.running = None  # unknown before the first reset

    def edge(self, rst_n, init, valid, data):
        """Apply one rising edge."""
        if not rst_n:
            self.running = START          # CRC-RESET
        elif init:
            self.running = START          # CRC-INIT: the reload wins over the byte
        elif valid:
            self.running = model_take_byte_bitwise(self.running, data)  # CRC-POLY
        # else: CRC-HOLD, no change

    def crc(self):
        return model_crc(self.running)


def read_crc(dut):
    v = dut.crc.value
    assert v.is_resolvable, f"crc is not 0/1: {v}"
    return int(v)


class Bench:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.model = Model()
        self.checks = 0

    async def start(self):
        cocotb.start_soon(Clock(self.dut.clk, 10, "ns").start())
        self.dut.rst_n.value = 0
        self.dut.init.value = 0
        self.dut.valid.value = 0
        self.dut.data.value = 0
        await FallingEdge(self.dut.clk)

    async def cycle(self, rst_n=1, init=0, valid=0, data=0, what=""):
        """Drive the inputs for one edge, then check crc after it.

        The bench is already at a falling edge when this is called.
        """
        d = self.dut
        d.rst_n.value = rst_n
        d.init.value = init
        d.valid.value = valid
        d.data.value = data
        await RisingEdge(d.clk)
        self.model.edge(rst_n, init, valid, data)
        await FallingEdge(d.clk)
        got = read_crc(d)
        exp = self.model.crc()
        assert got == exp, (
            f"{what}: crc=0x{got:02X} expected 0x{exp:02X} after edge with "
            f"rst_n={rst_n} init={init} valid={valid} data=0x{data:02X}"
        )
        self.checks += 1
        return got

    async def reset(self, cycles=3):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            await self.cycle(rst_n=0, what="reset")


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_model_against_hand_vectors(dut):
    """Check the three models against hand vectors and against each other."""
    hand = {0x00: 0xF3, 0xFF: 0x00, 0x80: 0x7A, 0x01: 0xF4}
    for byte, running in hand.items():
        assert model_take_byte_bitwise(0xFF, byte) == running, hex(byte)
        assert model_take_byte(0xFF, byte) == running, hex(byte)
        assert model_frame_poly(0xFF, [byte]) == running, hex(byte)
    assert model_frame_poly(0xFF, [0xFF, 0xFF]) == 0xF3
    # Linearity of the update in the byte.
    assert model_take_byte_bitwise(0x00, 0x01) == 0x07
    assert model_take_byte_bitwise(0x00, 0x80) == 0x89
    rng = random.Random(1)
    for _ in range(500):
        s, b = rng.randrange(256), rng.randrange(256)
        assert model_take_byte(s, b) == model_take_byte_bitwise(s, b), (s, b)
    for _ in range(200):
        frame = [rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 12))]
        r = START
        for b in frame:
            r = model_take_byte_bitwise(r, b)
        assert r == model_frame_poly(START, frame), frame

    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00, "CRC-EMPTY after reset"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_and_empty(dut):
    """CRC-RESET, CRC-EMPTY: reset loads 0xFF and wins over init and valid."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x5A, what="byte before reset")
    assert read_crc(dut) != 0x00
    # A byte is offered while reset is held: reset must win.
    await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, init=0, valid=1, data=0x5A, what="reset with valid")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    await bench.cycle(rst_n=0, init=1, valid=1, data=0xA5, what="reset with init+valid")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00
    # An empty frame after a reload.
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x11, what="byte before reload")
    await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
    assert read_crc(dut) == 0x00


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_single_bytes_hand_vectors(dut):
    """CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-FINAL: absolute values worked out from the spec."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    vectors = {0xFF: 0xFF, 0x00: 0x0C, 0x80: 0x85, 0x01: 0x0B}
    for byte, exp in vectors.items():
        await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
        got = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=byte, what=f"byte 0x{byte:02X}")
        assert got == exp, f"byte 0x{byte:02X}: crc 0x{got:02X}, hand value 0x{exp:02X}"
    # Two-byte frame FF FF.
    await bench.cycle(init=1, what="reload")
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xFF, what="FF first")
    got = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xFF, what="FF second")
    assert got == 0x0C, f"frame FF FF: crc 0x{got:02X}, hand value 0x0C"
    # Order matters: 0x80 and 0x01 give different crc values. A bit-reversed
    # design would swap them.
    await bench.cycle(init=1)
    a = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x80)
    await bench.cycle(init=1)
    b = await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x01)
    assert a == 0x85 and b == 0x0B, (hex(a), hex(b))


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_hold(dut):
    """CRC-HOLD: with valid low and init low the value does not change, whatever data is."""
    bench = Bench(dut)
    await bench.start()
    await bench.reset()
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0x3C, what="first byte")
    held = read_crc(dut)
    for d in (0x00, 0xFF, 0x55, 0xAA, 0x3C):
        got = await bench.cycle(valid=0, data=d, what="hold")
        assert got == held, f"hold changed crc to 0x{got:02X} from 0x{held:02X}"
    await bench.cycle(valid=1, data=0xC3, what="byte after hold")
    # CRC-FINAL: crc follows the running value with no extra edge, so it is
    # already stable a short time after the taking edge.
    dut.valid.value = 1
    dut.data.value = 0x42
    await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
    bench.model.edge(1, 0, 1, 0x42)
    await Timer(1, "ns")
    assert read_crc(dut) == bench.model.crc(), "crc must follow the running value combinationally"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=100, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_init_priority_and_midframe(dut):
